texts: During procurement, the part of the donor heart most at risk is the left atrium on its left side, where the left pulmonary veins enter: B.

When the lungs are taken as well, the left atrial cuff is shared between the two teams, and on the left side, close to the left pulmonary veins, too little atrial wall may be left for the anastomosis: the red lobby's left edge.
The right atrium, the venae cavae and the pulmonary artery are easier to see and to leave with enough length.
Memory hook: guard the red lobby's left edge when the money sacks leave with their pipes.
